description.en: The display name of the playbook.

description.zh:
请求和接收消息的语言类型。取值：

- **zh**：（默认）：中文。

- **en**：英文。
description.en:
The language of the content within the request and the response. Valid values:

*   **zh**: Chinese (default).
*   **en**: English.

description.zh:
要复制剧本的发布版本，默认为0。 取值：
- -1：代表正在编辑中的版本。

- 0：当前剧本的线上最新发布版本。
description.en:
The release version of the playbook that you want to copy. Default value: 0. Valid values:

*   \-1: The version that is being edited.
*   0: The latest online version of the current playbook.

description.zh: 管理员切换成其他成员视角的用户ID。
description.en: The ID of the user who switches from the current view to the destination view by using the management account.

description.zh:
视图类型。取值：

- **0**（默认）：当前账号视图。

- **1**：全局账号视图。
description.en:
The type of the view. Valid values:

*   **0** (default): the view of the current account.
*   **1**: the view of the global account.

description.zh:
要复制的剧本UUID。
>调用[DescribePlaybooks](~~3000306~~)接口可以获取该参数。
description.en:
The UUID of the playbook that you want to copy.

>  You can call the [DescribePlaybooks](~~DescribePlaybooks~~) operation to query the UUIDs of playbooks.

descriptions.zh: 请确保在使用该接口前，已充分了解响应编排产品（即威胁分析与响应日志接入流量）的收费方式和[价格](https://www.aliyun.com/price/product#/sas/detail/sas)。
descriptions.en: Before you call this operation, make sure that you understand the billing method and pricing of Security Orchestration Automation Response (SOAR) or pricing for the log data added to the Cloud Threat Detection and Response (CTDR) feature. For more information, see [Pricing](https://www.aliyun.com/price/product#/sas/detail/sas).
